title: Illustrated theme sheets (9)

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Organize illustration by recognizable city themes so authors can choose content relevant to a message.
strategic_value: A thematic library can make Helsinki’s varied everyday life visible without abandoning a shared illustration style.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: nine vertically stacked groups pair theme names and PNG/AI links with colorful illustration sheets.
practical_value: Select a theme and distinguish the raster preview from the Illustrator original.

content_islands.name: Theme list
content_islands.spec: Nine headings run from Diverse through Kivinokka-Kalasatama.

content_islands.name: Illustrated sheets
content_islands.spec: Each heading and link group sits beside its corresponding artwork and credit.

reference_purposes.Expression: Nine illustrated collages show people, food, neighborhoods, maritime seasons and city culture in a related visual style.
